description: This file defines public APIs, constants, enums, structures, and function prototypes for the USB BC1.2 battery charging detection driver in the Zephyr project. It includes definitions for roles, partner types, and callback mechanisms related to BC1.2 charging detection.

methods.name: bc12_set_role
methods.description: Sets the BC1.2 device role (disconnected, portable device, charging port).

methods.name: bc12_set_result_cb
methods.description: Registers a callback function to receive BC1.2 detection results.
